info.name: Trade Intelligence API
info.description: Postman collection for the Trade Intelligence analyze endpoint. Generates a rich intelligence report across five sections: Intelligence Summary, Doing Well, Holding Back, Repeating Patterns, and Discipline Health.

variable.description: Base URL of the Django server

request.description: Analyze trades for the last 30 days with no additional filters. This is the default behaviour when no timeRange is specified.

response.name: 200 OK — Full Report

request.description: Analyze trades for the last 7 days.
Analyze trades for the last 90 days.
Analyze trades for the last 365 days.
Analyze all available trade history with no date restriction.
Analyze trades within a custom date range. Both fromDate and toDate are required in YYYY-MM-DD format when timeRange is 'custom'.
Analyze trades filtered to a specific market type (e.g. forex, crypto, stocks). The filter is case-sensitive and matches the market_type field on the Trade model.
Analyze trades filtered to a specific broker. The match is case-insensitive.
Analyze trades filtered by both market type and broker over the last 90 days.
Full filter combination: custom date range with market and broker filters applied.
Request made without an Authorization header. Expects a 401 Unauthorized response.
GET request to a POST-only endpoint. Expects a 405 Method Not Allowed response.
